goal: produce a scratch-lineage HalfKP-64 model stronger than the v2.5.0 KPP-derived comparison weight

long_direct.conclusion: repeating the same game objectives improved WDoor ranking but did not improve play

diagnosis: The remaining gap is not explained by too few repetitions of the existing 537723-position game dataset; that line overfit after epoch 64.
Move-ranking proxy improvements have repeatedly failed to transfer to fixed-node search or direct play.
HalfKP-64 capacity is not the primary blocker because the v2.5.0 comparison model uses the same runtime architecture.
The untested low-complexity signal already supported by the repository is WDL regression to a blend of scratch-parent search value and the independent WDoor game result.

The accepted generation-2 parent is factor-only trained, while halfkp_search_train updates all direct HalfKP parameters, so search-value training can use the full model capacity without any KPP-derived target.

success_path: 100 ms and 100 games: score at least 45 percent
300 ms and 200 games: score at least 48 percent

prohibited: use v2.5.0 or any KPP-derived weight as initialization, teacher, target, anchor, or hard-negative miner
open the held-out test split before the final configuration is frozen
run a lambda, learning-rate, seed, or epoch grid
